#!/bin/bash
# calib_ok <device> <today YYYY-MM-DD>: succeeds while the device's calibration is valid
# (the due date itself is still valid). Records: $CALIB (default data/calibration.tsv).
calib_ok() {
  local file=${CALIB:-data/calibration.tsv} due
  due=$(awk -F'\t' -v d="$1" '$1 == d { print $2 }' "$file")
  [ -z "$due" ] && return 0
  [[ ! "$due" < "$2" ]]
}

arguments.command:
cat > lib/calib.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# calib_ok <device> <today YYYY-MM-DD>: succeeds only while the device's calibration is valid
# (the due date itself is still valid). Devices missing from the records are NOT ok.
# Records: $CALIB (default data/calibration.tsv).
calib_ok() {
  local file=${CALIB:-data/calibration.tsv} due
  due=$(awk -F'\t' -v d="$1" '$1 == d { print $2; exit }' "$file" 2>/dev/null)
  [ -z "$due" ] && return 1
  [[ ! "$due" < "$2" ]]
}
EOF
cat > bin/checkout <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: checkout <device> <user> <today YYYY-MM-DD>
# Appends device<TAB>user<TAB>date to $LOANS (default data/loans.tsv).
# Refuses devices whose calibration is expired or not on record.
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
loans=${LOANS:-$root/data/loans.tsv}
. "$root/lib/calib.sh"
CALIB=${CALIB:-$root/data/calibration.tsv}
if ! calib_ok "$1" "$3"; then
  echo "error: $1 has no valid calibration as of $3 (expired or not on record)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" >> "$loans"
echo "checked out $1 to $2"
EOF
cat >> tests/checkout_test.sh <<'EOF'
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='tests/checkout_test.sh'
s=open(p).read().replace('exit $fail\n','''# LAB-7: calibration
f=$(mktemp)
LOANS=$f bash bin/checkout OSC-2 t 2026-10-31 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "due date itself allowed"; fail=1; }
: > "$f"
for c in "OSC-2 2026-11-01" "FG-5 2026-11-01" "NOPE-9 2026-11-01"; do
  set -- $c
  LOANS=$f bash bin/checkout "$1" t "$2" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "$1 should be refused"; fail=1; }
done
[ ! -s "$f" ] || { echo "refused loans must not be recorded"; fail=1; }
rm -f "$f"
exit $fail
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
bash scripts/verify.sh; echo rc=$?; git status --short

steps.message:
LAB-7(Issue #7)の対応を commit しました(38a7ddf)。`scripts/verify.sh` は全テスト通過です。

- **前セッションの不具合**: `lib/calib.sh` の `calib_ok` は、校正記録にない機器を「OK」として通していました。Issue の要件と逆なので、拒否するよう直しました。期限日当日は貸し出せます。
